data.one_liner: Dart library for building Nostr clients with relay discovery, caching and signing support.
data.what_it_does: Provides high‑level Nostr use‑cases such as metadata, contact lists, NIP‑51 lists, encrypted messaging and Lightning payments while still allowing low‑level queries. It handles relay selection, caching, event verification and offers pluggable components for storage and signing.
use_when: You need to interact with the Nostr protocol in a Flutter/Dart app
You require automatic relay discovery, caching and multi‑signer support
You want a performant, extensible client with optional Rust‑based verification
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP/WebSocket calls without Nostr logic
You prefer a minimal dependency footprint
You are targeting platforms that cannot use FFI
strengths: Pluggable architecture for cache, verifier and signer
Performance optimisations with Rust verifier and isolate pool
weaknesses: Requires native toolchain for optional Rust verifier (FFI)
Complex API may have a learning curve
data.setup_notes: Optional Rust verifier needs native_toolchain_rust; choose a storage backend (in‑memory, ObjectBox, Sembast); no special permissions required

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple REST calls without Nostr‑specific features

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need raw WebSocket communication with relays
